titre: Devoir de synthèse n°1 - Anglais (3ème année secondaire)

exercices.enonce:
TEXT
Social media has changed the way we communicate, for better and for worse. On the positive side, platforms like Facebook and Instagram allow us to stay in touch with friends and family, even those living far away. They also help people share ideas, learn about the world and support important causes. Many young activists have used social media to defend human rights and protect the environment. On the negative side, however, social media can be dangerous. Some people become addicted and spend hours scrolling instead of studying or sleeping. Others compare their lives to the "perfect" images they see online and feel unhappy. Cyberbullying has also become a serious problem. Social media is a powerful tool, but like any tool, it can be used well or badly.

I. READING COMPREHENSION (8 marks)
1) Give two positive effects of social media mentioned in the text.   (2 marks)
2) How have young activists used social media?   (2 marks)
3) Give two dangers of social media mentioned in the text.   (2 marks)
4) What does the writer compare social media to at the end?   (2 marks)

II. LANGUAGE (6 marks)
1) Put into the present perfect: Social media (change) ______ the way we communicate.   (1,5 marks)
2) Complete with a linker (however / because): Social media is useful; ______, it can be dangerous.   (1,5 marks)
3) Give the comparative and superlative of "bad".   (2 marks)
4) Give the opposite of "positive" = ______.   (1 mark)

III. WRITING (6 marks)
"Is social media good or bad for teenagers?" Write a composition (about 12 lines) giving your opinion, with advantages and disadvantages. Use linkers.
